'''Michael Ganley''' (also published as '''Mike Ganley''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon III]] on 8 June 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2450">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twad2450/ ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twa], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 13 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twad2450/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Mike Ganley he played at [[2000 Phoenix Mega Tournament (4 November)]] on 4 November 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM (modeled after David Irvine's 'Deploy and Die')]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d1433">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-twod1433/ phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-two], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-twod1433/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and went 3–1 at the [[July 2001 Springfield tournament]] in Virginia.
